notes.title: THE NADI PROJECT UPDATE 1.5 OUT NOW !!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/66ff661c0a2c43e97c64864aea3cc99f6b047a81.png[/img]

We're proud to announce the very first huge update to version 1.5 after two years from the launch of the game !!!
We worked hard to increase user experience and add little more features in gameplay. We hope you can enjoy our work and play again with our new shining title !

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/6cc4beda29b918f125804d241622a694ab8c385d.jpg[/img]

Here the complete changelog:
[list]
    [*]Improved graphics and lights
    [*]A stunning fresh new english translation !
    [*]Global performance optimization
    [*]FIX collision system
    [*]FIX save system
    [*]FIX UI system
    [*]Fixed some dialogues
    [*]ADD options menu
    [*]ADD mouse sensibility controls
    [*]ADD Win64 build
    [*]ADD OSX build
    [*]Engine updates
    [*]Other minor bugs corrected
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/93e02162770c4f1128fea61869b4d90fb30bf78f.jpg[/img]

We've had an overwhelming response from the community, offering gameplay ideas, informative reviews and so much more so we'd like to take the opportunity to thank those who have chipped in! 

We hope you enjoy the game and please do let us know your thoughts in the comments section! Thank you all for reading. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/b18b847a93d4d9f97bdc9dfaff66a4b8fe3cf171.jpg[/img]

Don’t forget you can follow Monkeys Tales Studio on our [url=https://twitter.com/monkeys_tales] Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/monkeystales] Facebook[/url] page. 


See you soon !
Monkeys Tales Studio

notes.title: New trailer and release date for The NADI Project 1.5
notes.content:
Hello little monkeys,
here we are with the new [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=um501tWkwq0&t=3s] trailer[/url] and a release date for  "The NADI project" update 1.5 !

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/1b3e70af32638b7b657269c704c944d45d0b658f.jpg[/img]

Patch will be released on Friday 01/09/2017 and will be a MASSIVE update for our adventure:

[h1] Changelog: [/h1] 
[list]
    [*]Improved graphics
    [*]Improved english translation
    [*]Performance optimization
    [*]Fixed collision system
    [*]Fixed save system
    [*]Fixed UI
    [*]Fixed dialogues
    [*]Added options menu
    [*]Added sensibility controls
    [*]Engine updates
    [*]OSX build
    [*]Win64 build
    [*]Other minor bugs corrected
[/list] 

We worked very hard to improve our game experience, and we hope you can like it too.

For help and support: help@monkeystales.xyz
Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/monkeys_tales] Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/monkeystales] Facebook[/url] for more updates.

Thanks
Monkeys Tales Studio

notes.title: Update v1.3
notes.content:
We have released the first update for The NADI Project ! 
Below you can find the changelog: 

v1.3 

ADDED: 
- New audio for logo 
- Light flash in house and bunker 

IMPROVED: 
- Saves system 
- Steam integration 
- Minor performance optimizations 

FIXED: 
- Loading game from main menù after exit in gameplay 
- Player Collisions 
- Save status of moveable objects
